sources.claim: Start clears previous transfers and creates an assembler with nextSequence=start.sequence+1. Missing transfer or sequence mismatch deletes that transfer and returns pending with no ack. Valid chunk consumes tokens and yields ack. End deletes transfer, requires a complete value, and returns assembled message plus ack. Assembler rejects unmatched end/key placement/nested string chunks/missing string boundaries/incomplete or multiple roots. Object keys are assigned with Object.defineProperty.
